title: Eric hosts live conversation for Colombia and Latin America — 'putting our region on the map'
summary: María José Echeverri hosts Eric for a live 5pm conversation for Colombia's entrepreneur, corporate, investor, and student communities on innovation, entrepreneurship, and the lessons that have transformed ecosystems around the world — framed as bringing the conversations shaping the future of business closer to Latin America.
blockquote: Nunca imaginamos que años después íbamos a tener la oportunidad de conversar con Eric Ries, el autor de Lean Startup y uno de los escritores más reconocidos del mundo en tecnología.
